who_i_am.content:
I'm a frontend-first engineer with a strong product mindset.
I focus mostly on UI, UX, and how things actually feel for users, while backend and business logic are more like a __solid_bonus__ I bring to the table.
I've worked on __different_products__ and also tried building my own things - not all of them worked, but this experience shaped how I think about software, decisions, and trade-offs. I'm more about understanding the problem than just adding features.

how_i_work.content:
I usually prefer to think and plan first, then write code.
Not everything can be planned, but having a clear direction helps a lot.
I care about structure, maintainability, and simple solutions. Feedback is important for me - I work better when I know what's working and what's not. In general, I stay focused on product and try to be easy to work with, even when things are not perfect.

what_im_open_to.help: Let's see if our expectations match
what_im_open_to.content:
Right now, I'm open to different formats: full-time roles, long-term contracts, or well-defined projects.
What matters more to me is a clear role and a real product, not just "a position".
Ideally, I want to work as part of a team, but I'm also comfortable taking ownership when needed. If product is interesting and expectations are clear, I'm always open to talk.
